packet.title: XQuery Update Facility 3.0 and 4.0 (design and implementation, three packets)

item.p: Specifications: XQuery Update Facility 3.0:
2 (extensions to the processing model: updating expressions, pending update lists, snapshots);
3 (the insert, delete, replace, replace value of, rename and copy modify (transform) expressions, %updating functions, fn:put, revalidation declarations);
4 (update primitives and upd:applyUpdates, upd:mergeUpdates, upd:revalidate);
its error codes (XUST, XUDY, XUTY).
Also the XQuery Update Facility 4.0 community draft where the QT4 tests follow it (it is not yet a W3C draft: owner question 6).
Unlocks: XQ40 upd-* 825 cases, including revalidation (strict 21, lax 19, skip 34); upd-StaticTyping's 27 also need staticTyping, so they stay out.
Replaces: two places today. src/xquery_static.c rejects %updating as a reserved-namespace annotation (XQST0045), and the update expressions are not in grammars/xquery (XPST0003).
7.7a Design:
the AST kinds, and the IR's update primitives: an updating expression's value is a pending update list, carried as an internal item kind of the evaluator, not an XDM item;
how XQuery returns updated documents to the host: xquery.h, additive, an updating query and an update sink that receives each changed document as a new tree, plus fn:put's targets;
the sxml xquery design for updates (a flag that writes the changed documents);
the D-record.
7.7b Updating expressions and application:
the grammar (insert, delete, replace, rename, the copy-modify expression and %updating);
static rules (XUST0001, XUST0002) in src/xquery_static.c;
lowering of every updating expression into primitive constructors;
merging and the compatibility checks (XUDY0015, XUDY0016, XUDY0017, XUDY0024 namespace conflicts);
application by rebuilding each target tree through the tree builder with the primitives applied in the order of XQUF 3.0, upd:applyUpdates;
the copy-modify expression copies with sxml_tree_builder_copy_node and applies to the copy.
Node identity across an update cannot be observed inside one snapshot. Hosts get the new trees (XQUF 3.0, upd:applyUpdates: how the changes are made persistent is implementation-defined).

7.7c fn:put and revalidation: fn:put through the update sink; revalidation by the schema validator over the rebuilt tree (schema.h, ). 7.7a done 2026-10-19 (), with the 3.0 part of 7.7b as the owner's order asked (: 3.0 first): grammar, static rules, every 3.0 expression including transform-with and invoke updating, application, the xquery.h update sink, the QT4 driver and sxml xquery. upd-* 0 to 733 of 825 passed (10 wrong error), 24 failed, 0 errors, 68 not run; the gate's 85 % of 798 is 679. 7.7b is now the 4.0 draft's additions (the updating return clause of copy-modify, id-transform-expr-014; XUDY0038 for dynamic calls of updating function items), 7.7c fn:put (13 cases) and revalidation lax and strict (40 cases, XUST0026 today). Not in this packet: copies with construction strip keep is-id and is-idrefs (src/tree.c), which 11 cases need gone. 7.7b and 7.7c done 2026-10-19 (): fn:put through the update sink's receive_put_document (13 of 13), revalidation lax and strict (XUST0026 gone), copy-modify copies untyped and without schema IDs (sxml_copy_request.strips_identity, additive in tree.h), the 4.0 draft's updating return clause, setToUntyped for content going into an untyped node. upd-* 733 to 787 of 825 (98.6 % of the 798 in scope); left: 6 propagateNamespace cases whose expected whitespace differs from what their queries make, 2 that expect no IDREF check when an element is validated, 27 staticTyping, 3 for processors without a revalidation mode; XUDY0038 for simple dynamic calls of updating function items (no test).
Header: xquery.h, additive (7.7a). tree.h: none.
After: 7.7b after 7.7a; 7.7c after 7.7b.

Owns: grammars/xquery (the update productions), new src/xquery_update.c and src/xquery_update_internal.h, new src/evaluator_update.c, and the update hunks of src/xquery_static.c and src/xquery_lower.c.
Size: 0 in sxml.wasm (XQuery is not in it); 60–100 KB plus the grammar's growth in the CLI.
Gate: ≥ 85 % of the 825 (less the 27 static-typing cases).
